definition.zh-TW: 商品從進貨到賣出平均要放幾天，用一年的天數除以存貨週轉率算出。天數越少表示銷貨越快。
definition.en: The average number of days goods stay in stock before being sold, found by dividing the days in a year by inventory turnover. Fewer days mean faster selling.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
